name: RNAGym fitness leaderboard v0.1.1
description: Official RNAGym zero-shot fitness leaderboard: signed Spearman correlation between model scores and DMS fitness on 31 ncRNA assays (26 ribozyme, 3 tRNA, 2 aptamer), macro-averaged over the three categories.

attributes.scope_note: mRNA coding (37) and splicing (2) assays are excluded from v0.1.1. Signed, not absolute, Spearman.
attributes.source_locator: leaderboard/fitness/README.md, metric note and 'Why we now exclude the mRNA assays'
limitations: The leaderboard notes that ranks differing by less than about 0.01 should not be read as meaningful separations.
99.4% of ncRNA variants are multi-mutants; scores depend on the scoring convention.
